citations.text: Jie Tang, Jing Zhang, Limin Yao, Juanzi Li, Li Zhang, Zhong Su (2008). ArnetMiner: Extraction and Mining of Academic Social Networks. Proceedings of the 14th ACM SIGKDD International Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining.

description: Large-scale heterogeneous academic network from AMiner computer science corpus. Contains 3 node types (authors, papers, venues) with undirected co-authorship, authorship, and publication relationships. Used for node classification, clustering, and representation learning. Ground truth labels from Google Scholar Metrics.
